newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Paliburg details US$210 mln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Paliburg details US$210 mln bond issue.

text.p: Paliburg Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it is proposing to issue US$210 million worth of zero coupon guaranteed convertible bonds due 2002.
Paliburg has also granted an option to issue up to a further US$31.50 million worth of bonds, the statement said.
The bonds, to be issued by Paliburg's wholly-owned Paliburg Finance (C.B. 2002) Ltd, will be issued at par and redeemed at 145.875 percent of the principal amount on March 12, 2002, it said.
Application will be made to list the bonds in Luxembourg, it said, adding that they are expected to be issued on or about March 12.
Paliburg said the bonds would carry a right to convert into company shares at an initial conversion price of HK$10.50 per share up to March 5, 2002.
About 155 million shares, or 7.7 percent of the enlarged share capital, will be issued upon full conversion of the bonds.
The bonds are to be offered in Europe, the United States and to professional investors in Hong Kong, it said.
Jardine Fleming International Inc is the lead manager.
Net proceeds of about US$204.50 million will be used for general working capital, particularly for the development of property and related businesses in Hong Kong, Paliburg said.
Shares of Paliburg were down HK$0.10 at HK$9.40 in morning trade on Thursday.
